_comment: Tier-2 for dune::poisson#17 and _general.natural_bc_measured.Signal_unmasked_ds. Measured 2026-08-06 on dune-fem 2.12.0.2, wall time 30 s warm (two schemes). Problem: -Laplace(u)=0 on [0,1]^2 with u=0 on x=0 and du/dn=1 on x=1, whose answer is u=x. With the coordinate mask the P1 solution came back max 1.000000 and ||u_h - x||_L2 = 3.233e-16 — exact, because u=x lies in the P1 space and linear.tolerance was set to 1e-14. Writing the flux as g*v*ds instead of g*mask*v*ds gave max(u_h) = 2.163782, converged, no exception and no warning: a flux result that is a small multiple of the expected one is almost always this. NOTE on the tolerance: at the DEFAULT linear.tolerance the masked error is 1.038e-10, not 3.233e-16 — the 1e-16 figure is a solver-tolerance floor, not a discretisation one. The sibling claim poisson#8 is NOT re-tested here; the 'never' variant of dirichletbc_not_in_scheme_list_silent already solves that singular system, and duplicating it cost this fixture a 764 s run that had to be killed. MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 puts the correctly MASKED flux form in the slot where the base run puts the unmasked one. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectations 'unmasked_max=2.163782', 'unmasked_is_a_small_multiple_of_the_answer=True', 'dune_unmasked_ds_verified=True' are no longer printed and the forbidden token 'FAIL:' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness). ENVIRONMENT: there is no ofa-dune conda env on this host, which is the interpreter scripts/run_tier2_fixtures.py falls back to; dune-fem 2.12.0.2 lives in ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env. Without DUNE_PYTHON set to that interpreter the runner records this fixture as `skipped`, not `failed`, so a summary that counts only passes and failures shows nothing wrong while nothing was executed. Every measurement quoted above, and the mutation verdict, was taken with DUNE_PYTHON=~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python.
